name: Amazon ECS Cluster
description: AWS ECS cluster with comprehensive security controls and container orchestration

estimated_cost.notes: Costs vary by launch type, instance size, and usage patterns

prerequisites: VPC with subnets (for awsvpc network mode)
IAM roles (task execution role, task role)
Container images in ECR or Docker Hub
limitations: Fargate: 4 vCPU and 30 GB memory maximum per task
EC2: Limited by underlying instance resources

security_controls.name: Container Security
security_controls.description: Enforce read-only root filesystem and non-privileged containers

security_controls.name: Monitoring and Logging
security_controls.description: Enable CloudWatch Container Insights and comprehensive logging

security_controls.name: Execute Command Logging
security_controls.description: Log all ECS Exec commands for audit trails

security_controls.name: Secrets Management
security_controls.description: Use AWS Secrets Manager or Parameter Store for sensitive data

security_controls.name: Data Encryption
security_controls.description: Encrypt logs and data at rest and in transit

launch_types.name: Fargate
launch_types.use_case: Simplified container management without EC2 instances

network_modes.name: awsvpc
network_modes.description: Each task gets its own ENI

network_modes.name: bridge
network_modes.use_case: EC2 launch type with port mapping
